1.e4 b6 2.d4 c5 3.dxc5 Nc6.strategy: Develops instead of recapturing: a pawn gambit for activity and open lines. White can simply take a second pawn with cxb6 and keep the extra material, so Black has to prove the compensation is real.
1.e4 b6 2.d4 c5 3.dxc5 Nc6.name: Owen's Defence: Hekili-Loa Gambit
